description:
Trails identified as part of the Trails Master Plan. Includes the updates to trials on [Giant's Head Park](https://www.summerland.ca/parks-recreation/parks-trails/giants-head-mountain-trail-re-development-plan).

The District's description above references a document whose link on summerland.ca no longer resolves, so the reference is given as plain text rather than a broken link.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS object identifier assigned by the source service. Stable within one extract; not a durable key across refreshes.

table:columns.name: OwnBy
table:columns.description: Owned By. Coded values from the service's WS1_Park_AssetOwner domain: SUM = District Of Summerland; PRI = Private; RDOS = Regional District of South Okanagan; SD67 = School District 67; OTH = Other; UNK = Unknown; PROV = Province of British Columbia.

table:columns.name: Park_Name
table:columns.description: Coded values from the service's WS1_ParkNames domain: Turner St Park = Turner Street Park; Sunoka Beach Prov Park = Sunoka Beach Provincial Park; Soorimpt Prov Park = Soorimpt Provincial Park; Pyramid Prov Park = Pyramid Provincial Park; Mnt Conkle Park = Mount Conkle Park; Kickininee Prov Park = Kickininee Provincial Park; Hutton and Sinclair Boulevard = Hutton & Sinclair Boulevard; Dog Beach = Peach Orchard Dog Beach; Cres Beach South = Crescent Beach South Neighbourhood Park; Butler St Park = Butler Street Park; Beaver St Park = Beaver Street Park.

table:columns.name: Trail_Name
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 34 of 104 rows populated; 14 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Type
table:columns.description: Coded values from the service's WS1_Trail_Type domain: 1 = Multi-Use Trail; 2 = District of Summerland Trail; 3 = District of Summerland Paved Pathways; 4 = Trans Canada Trail; 5 = Other Paved Pathways; 6 = Other Trails; 7 = Signed Recreational Route; 8 = Off Street Pathway; 9 = District Right-of-Way Connections; 10 = Connector Trails; 11 = Giants Head Roadway; 12 = Giants Head Trails.

table:columns.name: Acess_Type
table:columns.description: Access Type. Permitted values: ATV, Multi-Use, Other, Pedestrian, Unknown, Vehicle.

table:columns.name: Width
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 99 of 104 rows populated; 10 distinct values.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS GlobalID assigned by the source service. More stable across refreshes than OBJECTID.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, in EPSG:26911 (NAD83 / UTM zone 11N) as the District publishes it. Reproject to EPSG:4326 to join against WGS84 data.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box, the GeoParquet 1.1 covering used for spatial predicate pushdown. Derived, not upstream data.

title: Trails
